messages:
anya: Quick sync — need to finalize evaluator thresholds for priority routing across regions & model variants.

sam: TL;DR?

anya: Proposal: per-tier latency SLOs + circuit-breaker rules. Gold+Plat: latency target 120ms p50, 250ms p95. Silver: 150ms p50, 400ms p95. Bronze: best-effort.

lia: That p95 for silver seems tight for eu-west on cold starts.

jamal: Agreed. Also need failure-rate CB: trip if >=5% error rate OR 5 consecutive 5xx within 30s.

kevin: Can we split by model variant? v2 (quantized) tolerates higher p95 but lower CPU error.

anya: Right. Example policy snippet:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "tiered-slo-v1",
  "tiers": {
    "platinum": {"p50":120, "p95":250, "cb": {"5xx_consec":3, "error_pct":0.03}},
    "gold": {"p50":120, "p95":300, "cb": {"5xx_consec":4, "error_pct":0.04}},
    "silver": {"p50":150, "p95":400, "cb": {"5xx_consec":5, "error_pct":0.05}}
  },
  "variants": {"default":"v1", "compat":"v2"}
}
```

sam: Console UX ask: we need a per-customer override toggle + visible reason when fallback happens. Ops needs link to last N traces.

lia: Telemetry names: use routing.slo.p95, routing.slo.p50, routing.cb.tripped, routing.cb.reason. Keep consistent.

jamal: Sampling: don't sample too low. Suggest full traces for first 30 minutes of rollout, then 5% sampling.

deploy-bot: deploy 1979008758 completed: policy/tiered-slo-v1 -> staging

kevin: For API, add param allow_override=true for enterprise customers; record audit log.

anya: Final question: thresholds per region? propose region multipliers: latency * 1.2 for apac, *1.1 for eu.

sam: sounds ok. I'll open a tiny RFC and add dashboard mockups.

lia: I can mock the console toggle and reason tooltip.

jamal: I'll wireup alerts: paging when cb_trips >3 in 5m for platinum.

opsbot: incident: circuit breaker tripped for eu-west-1/model-variant-v2 at 1979008740 — auto-fallback to compat-v1

anya: thanks — team will review RFC today. @sam pls tag product for final sign-off :thumbsup:
